description: This file defines a Perl package 'Coocook::Script::Deploy' which is a script for database maintenance based on App::DH. It sets up database schemas, handles deployment configurations, and creates a deployment handler object.

classes.name: Coocook::Script::Deploy
classes.description: A Perl package for database deployment scripting, extending App::DH, with custom schema and deployment configurations.

methods.name: _build_database
methods.description: Returns an array reference of supported database types: SQLite and PostgreSQL.

methods.name: _build__dh
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new Coocook::DeploymentHandler object configured with schema, force overwrite flag, script directory, database list, and target version.
